label: Рассказывать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for рассказывать (to tell, narrate).

missions.phrase: Я рассказываю детям сказку на ночь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Рассказываю' is the я-form with the -ю ending. The verb is imperfective; its perfective partner is рассказать.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Рассказываешь' shows the -ешь ending of the first conjugation. The topic is marked with 'о' plus the prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Рассказывает' is the она-form ending in -ет. 'Старую историю' is the accusative direct object being told.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Рассказываем' shows the мы-form ending -ем. 'Друг другу' is the dative recipient of the news.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Рассказывают' is the они-form with the -ют ending. 'Смешные шутки' is the plural accusative object.

missions.phrase: Я часто рассказывал ей о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Рассказывал' is the masculine singular past of imperfective рассказывать. 'Часто' fits the imperfective, marking a repeated habit of telling.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Рассказывала' adds the feminine -а ending. The imperfective stresses the unfolding process of recounting her childhood.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Рассказывали' is the plural past form ending in -и. 'Весь вечер' suits the imperfective, marking an ongoing evening of storytelling.
Strategic focus: Negated singular imperative. 'Рассказывай' is the informal command, here negated with 'не'. The imperfective imperative naturally tells someone not to do something.
Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Люблю' governs the bare infinitive 'рассказывать', the imperfective form. The sentence frames telling stories as a general pleasure.
